title: Business Insights scheduled reports: workplace, application and Data Explorer reports, and the exclusion list

prose.text: {{data-explorer-reports-page}} {{data-explorer-metrics}} The two articles name different dimensions {{divergence:data-explorer-grouping}}. {{data-explorer-aggregation}} {{gap:aggregation-options}} {{data-explorer-time-periods}} {{data-explorer-schedule}} {{data-explorer-export}}

{{gap:report-retention}} The applications the reports cover are in [[business-insights.applications]], the workplace metrics in [[business-insights.workplace]], and the product overview is in [[business-insights.overview]].

application-report-types.statement: An application report is either an Inactivity Period or an Activity Period report, with a cadence of 1 day, 30 days, 60 days or 90 days.

quotes: Inactivity Period: Select this option to generate the inactivity report for the application.
Activity Period: Select this option to generate the activity report for the application.
Cadence: Select the time frame for which you want to generate the report from 1 day, 30 days, 60 days, or 90 days.

application-report-delivery.statement: Application reports are scheduled for Daily, Weekly, Monthly or Quarterly delivery; the scheduling article describes scheduling activity reports for applications and distribution to various email recipients and Workflow Automation.

quotes: When - Delivery Schedule: Select the report generation and delivery schedule from Daily, Weekly, Monthly, or Quarterly.
You can schedule activity reports for applications and distribution to various email recipients and Workflow Automation.

application-report-subset-limit.statement: When an application report includes a subset of users, up to 128 users and departments can be selected.

quotes: You can select up to 128 users and departments.

application-report-exclusions.statement: An application report can exclude users via the Exclusion List and/or a Custom list; changes to the exclusion list affect all reports using it, and Zscaler recommends the Custom option for report-specific exclusions.

quotes: Exclusion List: Select this option to exclude the users and departments configured in the exclusion list.
Custom: Select this option to add custom users and departments to exclude from the report.

Any modification to the exclusion list affects all the scheduled reports where Exclusion List is applied. To exclude report-specific users, Zscaler recommends enabling the Custom option and selecting users and departments.

exclusion-limit-and-match.statement: In the Application Reports Exclusion List, multiple exclusions can be added but only up to 8 can be enabled at any time; an exclusion is associated only with scheduled reports whose applications match the exclusion's applications.

quotes: You can add multiple exclusions, however you can only enable up to 8 exclusions at any time.
The enabled exclusions must also match the applications configured in the scheduled reports for the exclusion to be associated with the reports.
You can add multiple exclusions, however you can only enable up to 8 exclusions at any time.

exclusion-enable-disable.statement: In the Application Reports Exclusion List, disabling an exclusion disassociates it from all scheduled reports using the exclusion list; only enabled exclusions are associated, and reports are generated with the latest exclusion list after any disable, modify or enable.

quotes: Disabling an exclusion disassociates it from all the scheduled reports using the exclusion list. Only enabled exclusions are associated with scheduled reports at any time.
Application Reports > Exclusion List.
Whenever you disable, modify, or enable an exclusion, the existing scheduled reports that use the exclusion list are generated considering the latest exclusion list.

exclusion-list-reports-column.statement: The Application Reports Exclusion List drawer shows, per exclusion, its users, departments, applications and the number of reports the exclusion is associated with.

quotes: Users: The users selected for exclusion from reports.
Departments: The departments selected for exclusion from reports.
Applications: The application selected for exclusion from reports.
Reports: The number of reports the exclusion is associated with.

enable-disable-report.statement: The enable/disable article, reached from Workplace Reports or Application Reports, says disabling a scheduled report stops report generation and distribution to recipients and that enabling it resumes them.

quotes: Disabling a scheduled report stops report generation and distribution to the recipients and vice versa when you enable a report.
go to Analytics > Reports > Business Insights Reports > Workplace Reports or Application Reports.

data-explorer-scheduled-column.statement: The Data Explorer Reports page lists, per scheduled report, a Scheduled column that indicates whether the report is active or not.

quotes: Scheduled: Indicates whether the report is active or not.

workplace-report-delivery.statement: Scheduled workplace reports are emailed to recipients as links, with a Time Period of Daily, Weekly or Monthly.

quotes: The scheduled reports are emailed as links to the recipients.
Time Period: Select Daily, Weekly, or Monthly as the time period for the workplace attendance report.

workplace-report-frequency.statement: A workplace report's Frequency (data aggregation) can be Daily, Weekly, Monthly or Quarterly and must be less than or equal to the selected Time Period.

quotes: Frequency: Select the data aggregation time period for the report from Daily, Weekly, Monthly, or Quarterly.
You must select the time period less than or equal to the value selected in the Time Period field.

workplace-report-remote-users.statement: Workplace report office selection has four options: All Offices (excluding remote users), Select Offices, All Offices and Remote Users, and Remote Users; users with zero office visits are categorized as remote users.

quotes: All Offices: Select this option to include all the offices in the report except the remote users.
Select Offices: Select this option to choose the offices for which you want to generate the report.
All Offices and Remote Users: Select this option to include all the offices and remote users in the report.
Remote Users: Select this option to generate the report for all remote users.

evidence.after: All Offices: Select this option to include all the offices in the report except the remote users.
quotes: Users with zero office visits are categorized under remote users.

workplace-report-organize-by.statement: The scheduling article says a workplace report organized by Office shows date, workplace and visits, and organized by User shows user, date, timespan and workplace.

quotes: Office: Select this option to organize the data in the report based on the office.
Workplace: The workplace name.
Visits: The number of visits on that date.
User: The name of the user.
Timespan: The time spent in the office during the visit.
Workplace: The name of the workplace visited by the user.
Select this option to organize the data in the report based on individual users and the time spent in the office.

evidence.after: Office: Select this option to organize the data in the report based on the office.
quotes: Date: The attendance date.

evidence.after: Select this option to organize the data in the report based on individual users and the time spent in the office.
quotes: Date: The attendance date.

data-explorer-metrics.statement: A Data Explorer view can combine the metrics Bytes, Visits, Transactions, Occupancy and Attendance, grouped by Office or Work Mode, with filters for Geolocation and Work Mode.

quotes: In the Metrics section, select the metrics for the view. You can select multiple metrics:
- Bytes - Visits - Transactions - Occupancy - Attendance
Select an option to group data by:
- Office - Work Mode
narrow the results of your view for a specific Geolocation and Work Mode.

data-explorer-aggregation.statement: In Data Explorer the Aggregation Type function (Sum, Maximum, Minimum, Average) is not available for daily aggregation.

quotes: Select the data aggregation function:
- Sum - Maximum - Minimum - Average
This option is not available for daily aggregation.

data-explorer-time-periods.statement: A Data Explorer view processes data for the Last 7 days, Last Day, Last Week, Last Month, Week, Month or 3 Months.

quotes: select an option to process the data for the Last 7 days, Last Day, Last Week, Last Month, Week, Month, or 3 Months.

data-explorer-schedule.statement: A Data Explorer view can be scheduled only when the time period is Last Day, Last Week or Last Month; the schedule delivers Daily or Weekly.

quotes: You can schedule Data Explorer reports only when the time period selected is Last Day, Last Week, or Last Month.
Deliver: Select the report generation frequency (i.e., Daily or Weekly).

data-explorer-export.statement: Data Explorer results can be exported as a CSV file (Export) or as a detailed report (Export Full Report).

quotes: Click Export Full Report to download a detailed report.
Click Export to download the data as a CSV file.

data-explorer-reports-page.statement: The About Data Explorer Reports article says Data Explorer reports can be organized by department, geolocation, user or workplace.

quotes: Generate organized reports based on department, geolocation, user, or workplace.

workplace-report-columns.summary: The workplace report scheduling article lists a short set of columns for the Office and User organizations, while the 2025 release summary says scheduled workplace reports gained many CSV columns and a User Aggregated Daily report type.

quotes: Visits: The number of visits on that date.
Timespan: The time spent in the office during the visit.

positions.says: The scheduling article describes Office reports as date, workplace and visits and User reports as user, date, timespan and workplace.

quotes: Scheduled workplace reports are enhanced with the following new columns in the CSV file, depending on the report type:
User Aggregated Daily

positions.says: Scheduled workplace reports gained new CSV columns depending on report type, with Office, User and User Aggregated Daily listed as report types.

workplace-report-columns.impact: The column sets in the scheduling article are not the complete CSV contents, and the article does not describe the User Aggregated Daily type.

data-explorer-grouping.summary: The About Data Explorer Reports article says reports can be organized by department, geolocation, user or workplace, while the Data Explorer view configuration article groups by Office or Work Mode and filters on Geolocation and Work Mode.

quotes: Generate organized reports based on department, geolocation, user, or workplace.

positions.says: Data Explorer reports can be organized by department, geolocation, user or workplace.

quotes: Select an option to group data by:
- Office - Work Mode
narrow the results of your view for a specific Geolocation and Work Mode.

positions.says: A view groups data by Office or Work Mode and can be narrowed by Geolocation and Work Mode.

data-explorer-grouping.impact: Which dimensions a scheduled Data Explorer report can actually be organized or grouped by is not settled; the report article lists dimensions the view configuration does not offer.

data-explorer-enable-disable.title: Whether a Data Explorer report can be enabled or disabled
data-explorer-enable-disable.detail: The enable/disable article covers Workplace Reports and Application Reports; the Data Explorer Reports page lists a Scheduled column and a Schedule Report toggle but no enable or disable action.

quarterly-frequency.title: Whether Quarterly Frequency is reachable on a workplace report
quarterly-frequency.detail: A workplace report's Time Period offers Daily, Weekly or Monthly and its Frequency offers up to Quarterly but must not exceed the Time Period, so no stated combination reaches Quarterly.

delivery-method.title: Whether application reports can go to Workflow Automation
delivery-method.detail: The application report scheduling article's introduction mentions Workflow Automation, but its Delivery Method option lists only Email.

aggregation-options.title: Which Data Explorer aggregation options exist besides daily
aggregation-options.detail: The Data Explorer view lists only Daily as an aggregation option in the captured article, yet says the Aggregation Type function is not available for daily aggregation.

report-retention.title: How long generated reports and emailed report links last
report-retention.detail: The captured articles do not state the retention of generated reports or the lifetime of the links emailed to recipients.
